description: Change a SwOS switch's admin password, as the web UI's Password Change does. The new password comes from the server secret MIKROMCP_PASSWORD_<newPasswordSecret>, never from the conversation; the current one is the router's configured credential. Passwords are ASCII, at most 15 characters. After the change this call's client keeps working with the new password, but the server rebuilds the client from the router's configured credential ({PREFIX}_PASS) after any authentication failure or restart, so that variable must be updated right away. On SwOS Lite the switch does not answer the change; the result is confirmed by logging in with the new password. dryRun defaults to true.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Check the secret and the switch without changing the password.

newPasswordSecret.description: Name of the server secret holding the new password: NAME for MIKROMCP_PASSWORD_<NAME>. The password itself never passes through the conversation, and a switch config cannot reference it.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: set_swos_password
title: Set SwOS Password
